title: Current Reality Tree Input
description: Input schema for crt_builder.py and clr_validator.py

udes.description: List of Undesirable Effects — the observable symptoms to be explained

description.description: Declarative present-tense statement of the undesirable effect

type.description: 'causes' for a standard arrow; 'and_causes' when this arrow is part of an AND-connector group (both conditions required)

rationale.description: The causal mechanism — why does the cause produce the effect in this specific context?

nodes.description: Optional map of node_id to description for intermediate cause nodes. Used by clr_validator.py for tautology checks.

udes.description: Customer churn rate exceeds 8% per quarter
Sales cycle length has increased from 30 to 75 days

connections.rationale: Customers cancel when they do not achieve the outcomes they purchased the product to solve
Generic onboarding does not help customers apply the product to their specific workflows, so value realization is delayed or missed
Without proactive guidance, customers encounter obstacles they cannot self-resolve
When prospects cannot quickly understand product value, they request more demos and extend evaluation periods before committing

nodes.C1: Customers are not achieving desired outcomes with the product
nodes.C2: Onboarding is generic and not tailored to customer workflows
nodes.C3: Customer success team lacks capacity for proactive engagement
nodes.C4: Prospects cannot quickly understand the product value proposition
